name: Sword of the Squeak
blocked_sentences: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each creature you control with base power or toughness 1.

needs.what: base_power and base_toughness (with a union, i.e. any_of, so 'base power OR toughness 1' counts a creature once) in the filter of a static's magnitude `count`, so a buff can be sized by {"count": {"controller": "you", "types": ["Creature"], "any_of": [{"base_power": 1}, {"base_toughness": 1}]}}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: base_power/base_toughness exist only in selector_keys (effect selectors); a static's `count` is filtered by static_filter_keys, which has neither base_power, base_toughness nor any_of. `power`/`toughness` read current values (wrong once the creature is pumped, e.g. by this very Equipment), and static_value_keys has no subtraction to build the union from two counts
